description: Nested dry run of the physical validation kit (tools/physical). NOT a physical measurement: KWin virtual backend, QPainter compositing, synthetic 60 Hz presentation timeline, libei input instead of uinput, shared 4-vCPU cloud container. It shows that the pipeline (injector, correlation, randomized blocks, warmup separation, summarizer, verdict logic, key-delivery check, session guard) works end to end against a real KWin 6.7.5; its latency numbers say nothing about physical input-to-visible latency.

environment.captureNote: Plastile src/ and package/ were at 6ada721 (unchanged by WP-10); the kit ran from its working tree just before commit f500cb8 (implementationDirty=true refers to that); summaries were recomputed from the raw logs with the committed kit (orchestrate.py correlate). Raw logs stay in the gitignored artifacts/physical/.
